text:
deploy-bot: pinlist update: runtime v2.14 auto-added to soft-pin group by autoscan (reason: kernel_mismatch=0.12)

maria_p: saw that. looks like SDK v1.4 isn't pinned for the same model group. :eyes:

alex_w: that's risky — runtime and sdk mismatch causes unexpected errors in longseq. we should block rollout until reconciled.

samir: any metric spikes from canary?

deploy-bot: metric snapshot: error_rate +0.3% across canary, latency p95 +120ms on longseq. triggered rule: kernel_mismatch_threshold.

jin_q: triage from eng-runtime: mismatch due to quantized kernel selection. newer SDK advertises q-kernel capability; older SDKs don't. runtime soft-pin happened before SDK check.

maria_p: proposal: update pinlist heuristics so runtime soft-pins only if matching SDK capability is present. proposed rule:
```
# pin heuristics (pseudo)
if runtime.kernel_compat < 0.85 and not sdk.advertises_qkernel:
    do_not_soft_pin()  # alert eng-runtime + eng-ml
else:
    soft_pin(runtime)
```

alex_w: +1. also add rollout guard: canary <= 2% traffic and absolute error increase < 0.5% sustained for 10m, else auto-rollback.

ops-oncall: I'll reserve a 15m change window (15:30-15:45 PT) and stand by to rollback if the error delta crosses threshold. /cc @samir

samir: opening PR with heuristics + unit tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploybot/pull/789. requesting review from @jin_q and @alex_w.

maria_p: QA will run a canary sweep after the PR lands and post results here. will check model groups that exercised kv-cache and longseq. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: holding runtime v2.14 as soft-pin-hold until PR merges and CI passes. will re-evaluate at merge.

alex_w: if CI green, let's coordinate a staged unhold: 0.5% -> 1% -> 2% traffic over 30m windows. document in release notes.

jin_q: noted. I'll add compatibility note in runtime release notes and link to PR.

ops-oncall: acked. tagging incident-runbook channel in case of rollback. :white_check_mark:

maria_p: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single-source-of-truth for the pinlist heuristic change.
